description.value: A McDonald's fast food restaurant in North Vancouver offering burgers, chicken, McCafé beverages, and a full breakfast menu. The location includes a drive-through and takeaway service. As a major chain stop on a cycling route, it offers predictable, quick-service food and a recognizable rest point.
